summary: 10.0.41.11 Universal UI/UX Deep Forensic Investigation, Table Amount Colorization, Side Panel & Header Polish, Purchase Recon Rework, Tab Standardization, Bank Statement Refresh Fix & 3D Icons, and Dark/Light Mode Parity
highlights: 1. Universal Table Monetary Amount Colorization: Defined missing core semantic variables and .amount-* utilities across :root and body.light-theme with real-time DOM mutation observer coverage.

2. Side Panel (Detail Drawer) & Header Polish: Integrated tactile 3D badges into drawer labels, colorized drawer totals, and upgraded page view titles and multi-document workspace tabs with 3D elevation.

3. Purchase Reconciliation (PRC) Complete Rework: Placed 6-card KPI ribbon on top, streamlined single-row filter bar, activated date preset chips, defaulted period to Start of FY through Today, and installed 2027 enterprise pagination footer.
4. Navigation Tabs Standardization: Excluded navigation tabs from action button coloring across Settings and Registers, enforcing unified 2027 glassmorphic tab tokens in dark and light modes.
5. Action Button Clean-up: Purged triple colons and artifacts from button text, assigning clean 3D action roles.
6. Centralized Modal Dialog Parity: Guaranteed single-action buttons on informational alerts and toasts, removing accidental cancel buttons and applying 3D role gradients.
7. Bank Statement Screen Parity: Resolved Refresh button undefined batch ID exception and added 3D colorful icons and themes to all 8 KPI cards.
8. Strict Dark & Light Mode Color Contrast: Enforced WCAG AAA contrast compliance across all semantic tokens in both dark and light modes.
